Miranda Lambert, that's Mama's Broken Heart on Pure American Country.
Casey Musgraves, Brandi Clark, and Shane McAnally wrote that one together
and Shane came into the room talking about his sister was going through a terrible breakup
and his mom not being particularly impressed with the way she was handling.
And that became the collision at the center of the song.
One generation saying, pull yourself together and don't let anybody see the mess.
And another one saying, hey, this ain't your breakup.
But there's another story behind that record.
Miranda wanted that song so badly that she approached Casey at her own wedding rehearsal dinner
and said, hey, you going to record that one?
And Casey said, well, you can have it on one condition if I get to sing harmony.
So if you listen closely to Miranda's record, Casey Musgraves is still there in the background.
And those same three writers, Casey, Brandy, and Shane, well, they got together again for this one.
And Casey recorded this one herself.
Here's Biscuits on Pure American Country.
